summary: When Concur v4 rejects reports create with policyId required, retry via the real Create Report UI. Derive that UI host only from a trusted original API hostname (port-stripped, case-insensitive, before www-/api. rewrite) or CONCUR_UI_BASE_URL; refresh the CDP attach port per invocation; treat post-click failures as possible partial success.
reason: Some tenants require an expense policy ID the CLI cannot supply, so the HTTP path cannot succeed. Trusting a host only after rewrite, guessing a UI region, or reusing a previous invocation's CDP port can open the wrong Concur UI or a dead browser. A retry-looking error after the irreversible Create Report click can duplicate a real report.
validated_outcome: Unit tests cover policyId fallback, interstitial dismiss, resolveReportsUIHost (explicit port, uppercase host, lookalike-before-rewrite), partial-success errors, and stale CDP port clearing. A live tenant run created and submitted a real report via the fallback path.

deferred_to_upstream.feature: Generic auto-detect-and-fallback-to-browser for any printed CLI mutation that live-fails on a tenant-config-dependent required field the generator has no way to discover ahead of time (this instance: Concur's policyId on report creation).
deferred_to_upstream.reason: Only observed once so far (this concur-pp-cli instance). Kept CLI-specific rather than opening a cli-printing-press generator issue on a single data point; noting the pattern here so a second independent sighting has a paper trail to point back to before generalizing.
